pr.title: Referenced IRIS items link to their library entry page, not IRIS
pr.body:
Part of #207. Owner, 2026-11-10, card Q-IRIS-5 = A: "i dont wnat this this link to go to iris, but our ingested record in linbrary and associated KG".

## What
- `gen-iris-pages.ts`: an item catalogued by reference now links its title and cover to `en/cat-harness/library/who-iris/<record stem>/`. The library page comes from litlfred/cat-harness-tools#1765 and shows:
  - the Dublin Core **XML**
  - the KG node
  - the Handle
  - the PDF on IRIS
- The rail nav still lists held items only, so it does not grow with Stage 2.
- Regenerated home, search and catalogue pages.
- New test `referencedItemsLinkToLibraryNotIris`, with its `.feature` scenario.

## Order
1. Merge cat-harness-tools#1765.
2. Re-pin tools here, in this PR.
3. Stage and merge.

Until step 2, these links 404 on a published site.
